intent: When the last active turn ends, schedule a full knowledge rescan so outside edits are picked up at idle boundaries.
Keep the last max_output_bytes of command output instead of the first, and count every byte read.
Prefer the default model when it is installed and none was selected; otherwise fall back to the first installed model.
Stop keeping a copy of every displayed event in conversation state; keep only pending prompts and recent turns.
Let only the USER select the chat model, and record the event under the caller's actor label.
